work_packages.title: Genesis, Constitution, Progress, Decisions, and Dogfooding
work_packages.objective: Establish repository-native memory and controls before domain pipeline implementation.

work_packages.title: Idea Maturation Pipeline
work_packages.objective: Transform raw ideas into approved concept packages without losing assumptions or alternatives.

work_packages.title: Specification Pipeline
work_packages.objective: Transform approved concepts into baselined requirements, architecture, decisions, verification, and readiness packages.

work_packages.title: Bootstrap Package and Repository Binding
work_packages.objective: Seal pre-repository state, bind the correct repository, import artifacts, and activate repository-native authority.

work_packages.title: Foundry Kernel
work_packages.objective: Define only shared semantic contracts proven necessary by multiple pipelines.

work_packages.title: Repository Foundation Compiler
work_packages.objective: Inspect, reconcile, apply, and validate profile-driven repository foundations.

work_packages.title: Execution Program and Task Decomposition
work_packages.objective: Compile approved specifications into traceable work packages, tasks, dependencies, and prompt units.

work_packages.title: Serial and Parallel Planning
work_packages.objective: Plan candidate concurrency and re-evaluate live dispatch eligibility.

work_packages.title: JIT Prompt Orchestration
work_packages.objective: Generate precise live-state-bound implementation prompt envelopes and rendered prompts.

work_packages.title: Completion Verification and Continuity
work_packages.objective: Verify branch, PR, Merge, current-main completion, then preserve exact resume state.

tasks.title: Establish governed repository foundation
acceptance_criteria: North Star, complete program, scope, current state, and next work have canonical carriers.
Decision Intelligence and Dogfooding protocols are present.
Cross-file validator and CI workflow pass.
Completion is not claimed before current-main verification.

tasks.title: Research and select the MVP dogfooding implementation strategy
acceptance_criteria: Feasible strategies are found from relevant current sources.
Hard constraints, criteria, weights, uncertainty, and trade-offs are recorded.
AI operability and owner usability are explicit criteria.
A bounded MVP strategy is selected and recorded.

tasks.title: Run the first self-hosting checkpoint and promote validated foundation lessons
acceptance_criteria: Observed challenges are separated from proposed rules.
Promotion decisions identify carrier and evidence.
The complete program remains visible after the checkpoint.

tasks.title: Design Idea Maturation Pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Approved Concept Package contract is defined and tested.

tasks.title: Design Specification Pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Implementation Readiness Package contract is defined and tested.

tasks.title: Design Bootstrap Package and Repository Binding
acceptance_criteria: Repository-native activation is identity-bound and evidence-backed.

tasks.title: Define minimal Foundry Kernel from proven shared needs
acceptance_criteria: Every Kernel concept has multiple consumers or a cross-pipeline invariant.

tasks.title: Implement profile-driven Repository Foundation Compiler
acceptance_criteria: Foundation reconciliation is idempotent and non-destructive.

tasks.title: Implement Execution Program Compiler
acceptance_criteria: Tasks are traceable to approved specification baselines.

tasks.title: Implement Task Decomposition Compiler
acceptance_criteria: Prompt units are atomic, bounded, complete, and non-overlapping.

tasks.title: Implement Queue and Concurrency Planner
acceptance_criteria: Parallel implementation and Merge ordering are evaluated separately.

tasks.title: Implement JIT Prompt Compiler and Dispatch Protocol
acceptance_criteria: Prompts are rendered from canonical envelopes bound to live state.

tasks.title: Implement Completion Verifier
acceptance_criteria: Completion requires exact current-main evidence.

tasks.title: Implement Continuity and Rebaseline Engine
acceptance_criteria: A new session can recover the exact next safe action without chat memory.
